basic_info.description: Special, renovated, Queen Anne Victorian 2 lvl Cole Valley home! Expansive double parlor w nearly 11 ft ceilings, bay windows, and a marble, w/b fireplace. Spacious DR w soaring ceiling opens to the kitchen - the perfect entertaining flow! Luxurious, pro kitchen w Carrera marble countertops and backsplash, Subzero refrigerator, Viking range, Miele dishwasher, and an extra deep marble island with ample seating. The kitchen opens to a light-filled family room and to a sun-drenched deck and garden, and to a skylit bath. Upstairs, 3 spacious BDRs and 2 full BAs all on one level. The spa-like primary suite offers a walk-in closet, a sumptuous marble tiled ensuite BA w a soaking tub and separate standup shower, and a 2nd marble w/b fireplace. Plus another huge, tiled family BA. Giant 3 car garage w EV charger, and washer/dryer. Renovated to the studs in 2012-13 w structural, electrical, and plumbing updates. Refinished warm wood floors and fresh paint. A walker's paradise, steps to world class markets, restaurants, and cafes. 98 WalkScore -5 min walk to Whole Foods and to the iconic Golden Gate Park. Easy walk to the Japanese Tea Garden, Conservatory of Flowers, dog park, tech shuttles, the N-Judah, and several MUNI lines. 87 BikeScore -ride your bike to Ocean Beach. The whole package!
